scope: s 39(3) (filing for divorce in Australia); ss 48, 49, 50(1), 52 (12 months' separation, separation under one roof, one reconciliation aggregated, nullity first); ss 55(1)-(4), 55A, 59 (when the divorce takes effect; the children condition; marrying again); s 60F(1), ss 69ZE, 69ZH (child of the marriage; Part VII's reach in WA); ss 61B-61D (parental responsibility survives separation); ss 60CA, 60CC (best-interests considerations); s 60I(7)-(9) (family dispute resolution certificate and exemptions); ss 63B, 63C, 63D, 65DAB (parenting plans and what they are worth); s 44(3), (4) (property proceedings within 12 months of the divorce taking effect; leave); s 79(1)-(2) (just and equitable; the s 79(4)-(5) weighing not encoded); s 44(5)(a)(i), s 90RA (de facto: 2 years; WA not a referring State, WA de facto property under the Family Court Act 1997 (WA), not this Act); Rules rr 4.01, 15.15. Out: courts and jurisdiction, counselling, nullity, rescission, parenting order contents, child and spousal maintenance, child support, superannuation splitting, financial agreements, enforcement
